description: This file is a shell script designed to collect and log remote port usage information by querying device information via dmcli, processing network connections with conntrack, and sending telemetry data. It primarily interacts with system network tools and custom diagnostic logging.

methods.name: t2ValNotify
methods.description: Sends a notification to the telemetry client with a specified marker and message.

methods.description: Prints the current timestamp and a message to standard output.
